verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a cloud meeting-notes product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows a self-hostable deployment of Granola. The docs describe a hosted service with a public API at public-api.granola.ai and an MCP connector, and community users looking for self-hosted or local processing turn to other tools. That leaves this applicable capability unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
